root_cause: RuPay Debit transactions were incorrectly charged MDR fees despite regulatory zero-MDR mandates.
diagnosis: The acquirer levied MDR fees totaling Rs 807.34 across 9 RuPay Debit transactions where the expected fee according to regulatory rules (R2) is Rs 0.00.
action_rationale: Requesting a refund directly recovers the illegal MDR overcharges levied on zero-rated RuPay Debit transactions.
